[SWS_DM_01037] Behavior of not configured
DiagnosticEvent.confirma-
tionThreshold
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04067
⌈
If the optional parameter
DiagnosticEvent.confirmationThreshold
is not
configured, the DM shall use a default value of ’1’ for that parameter.
⌋
This means that a confirmedDTC is set to ’1’ along with a reported
kFailed
monitor
action
result.
7.3.4.4.2.2 UDS DTC Status change notifications
